entries.323dd60d2fbe3d97: An automotive parts manufacturer that makes functional parts for automobiles, such as suspensions, subframes, and pedals, in Japan, North America, and Asia.
entries.6a7567bb4300b04b: The Company and its domestic subsidiaries manufacture and sell automotive parts, and the Company also handles research and development, centered on the Haga Technical Center in Tochigi Prefecture. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,453 million.
entries.9f6e256a2993359e: Local subsidiaries in China, the Philippines, Thailand, Indonesia and India manufacture and sell automotive parts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥39,797 million.
entries.aeef17f407837c92: Local subsidiaries in the United States, Canada and Mexico manufacture automotive parts and sell them to local automobile manufacturers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥222,616 million, the largest of the 3 regions.
